Previous exact stop required first, then main stop; nullable expiry comparison only when supplied; strictly later rejects, equality passes. No general requirement for current stop yet.
Call virtual inheritance after previous-stop admission; nonnull result selects exclusive inherited branch. Unpack four values including inherited Reaction Break time, unused afterwards.
Search inherited level starting at current formation through exclusive expiry, using A07. None returns immediately, no fallback to another route; ignore crossing extreme.

Return inherited level/source, trigger main read from candle index, exact trigger, effective previous stop main equals level source time, effective current equals trigger main (timestamp reread). No equality assertion with actual stops.

Without inherited tuple, previous exact stop strictly earlier than current formation selects early-stop route. Read current formation main open and call A08 from previous exact stop through open minus one microsecond inclusive. Same-main guard can pass while range reverses; A08 raises.
Reread formation main open then add nominal timeframe; if expiry nonnull choose min(nominal end,expiry), else nominal end. No independent reversal guard.
Search from exact current formation to exclusive computed endpoint; nonnull crossing gives trigger index/time, ignore returned extreme, read main timestamp once as effective stop.
Return frozen continuation source, trigger and exact event, previous actual main stop and effective current main stop; current actual stop may be absent.
Only after formation-window miss require current exact then main stop; expiry nonnull and current event > expiry rejects; equality permitted.
Search frozen level from current exact stop through exclusive expiry, None terminal; return continuation, trigger main/time, exact event and both actual main stops. No recourse to two-stop sort.
Remaining branch (previous stop >= current formation) repeats current exact/main and expiry gate before sort.

Stable ascending sort of previous,current by actual exact stop time then stop_level for exact bearish else native unary minus. Unary minus obeys Decimal context, not copy_negate; key evaluated for each state even if times differ; equal full keys retain input order.
Four assertions in source order: first event, second event, first event extreme, second event extreme nonnull. Subject to Python assertions enabled; second extreme required despite not used later.
Convert first sorted stop index to int; freeze its exact stop event extreme and mapped main timestamp as continuation. No extra conversion or scan.

Equal exact stop times yield direct second stop index, main timestamp, second exact event; no additional crossing, may equal expiry. Both effective stop mains remain original previous/current order, not sorted order.

Distinct times search first strict crossing of first exact stop extreme from second exact event through expiry exclusive. None terminal; otherwise return trigger and frozen first-stop source, original previous/current actual main stops.

Base delegate chronology.reaction_confirmation with explicit use_intrabar_start false. Native RE61 scans Break-open window, caches result or fallback; return unchanged, no independent exact-event proof.
Capture local references to reactions, precomputed First times and confirmations. Optional not_before and start_position=0, no local normalization.
Fast admission short-circuit: start>=0, ordered confirmations, exact datetime trigger, tzinfo None, then null not_before or ordered Firsts and exact naive bound. Break ordering flag not used here.

Position=max(start_position,left-bisect confirmations at inclusive trigger); if bound present max with left-bisect Firsts. Return ordinal position+1 and original reaction if position<len, else None; no recheck of stale flag or arrays.

Fallback native range from supplied start (negative not clamped), compare confirmation>=trigger first, then null bound or First>=bound. First qualifying returns number+1 and original reaction, possibly zero/negative ordinal for malformed starts. Exhaustion None; no sorting.
Require previous formation strictly earlier than current; equality rejects before any stop/internal reads.

Chain admission ordered conjunction: previous main stop nonnull, exact stop nonnull, exact stop strictly earlier than current formation, previous internal false, current internal false (default false). No check of current stop.

Only if not chained string-convert previous kind; exact scale rejects, all other kinds remain eligible. Window starts previous actual stop MAIN time if chained, else previous formation; not exact stop event in chained case.
Capture original Reaction and timestamp arrays, start=0. Only ordered Firsts with exact naive window start use right-bisect, excluding equality.
Ordered-limit flag uses Break order and exact naive current formation independently of First optimization.

Loop original positions; read both First and Break before gates. Skip First<=window_start before Break bound. Break>=current formation terminates only if ordered-limit, otherwise skip. Early termination conditional on eligible ordered data.

First eligible Reaction supplies endpoint: chained full nominal Break interval ends at Break open+timeframe minus 1 microsecond, nonchained ends at Break open inclusive. No recheck that chained end precedes formation; full Break may extend beyond it.

Call A08 with window_start and derived inclusive range end; propagate failure, no later candidate fallback. Return price, source main position/index/time and Break main time; no eligible reaction returns None.
